title: Why Nvidia says its AI partnerships aren't 'circular financing'
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered another blockbuster quarter, beating Wall Street's expectations as demand for AI infrastructure continues to surge. But amid growing scrutiny over Nvidia's investments in AI companies and data-center projects, questions about "circular financing" have taken center stage. On Nvidia's earnings call, CFO Colette Kress pushed back on that characterization, explaining why the chipmaker views its partnerships and investments as strategic opportunities, not simply a way to finance.

title: Tech stocks today: Meta agrees to settle social media case for $16.68 billion; Nvidia tops Q2 expectations
Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.
